d:
There has been a steady stream of news regarding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Following reports of an affair with Alice Huang, The New York Times has now published details about a link-up with Kimberly Powell, the company’s Vice President of the Healthcare division. However, our focus here is on Alice Huang—and her alleged husband. American agencies believe that Alice is a Chinese spy. Whether or not this is true remains to be seen, but it has been established that she has long-standing business ties with China.
